project_context.name: Deyede Custom Semarang
project_context.description: High-end company profile and catalog for a convection/garment business in Semarang.
project_context.target_aesthetic: Awwwards-level, strict monochrome art direction, high-fashion editorial, brutalist elegance.

rules: No generic gradients. Strictly high contrast.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers/overlays; use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-black/80.
The aesthetic relies on negative space and stark contrasts.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl font-serif tracking-tighter uppercase

rules: Avoid Inter, Roboto, and Space Grotesk completely.
Use massive typography for hero elements but strictly control body text size.
Use IBM Plex Mono for technical details, step numbers (01, 02), and meta-information to give a 'tailored/measured' aesthetic.
Use CSS grayscale (grayscale(100%)) on images to strictly maintain the monochrome aesthetic. Remove grayscale on hover (hover:grayscale-0) for interactive elements.

layout_and_grids.grid_strategy: The Bento/Editorial mix. Sharp edges, 1px white/20 borders. No rounded corners (rounded-none).
layout_and_grids.hero_section: Full screen (h-screen). Absolute positioning of the signature_background behind content with opacity-40 or mixed blend mode. Content centered or dramatically left-aligned.
layout_and_grids.navigation: Sticky top, bg-black/80 with backdrop-blur-xl. Must contain Logo, Links (Beranda, Katalog, Cara Pesan, Tentang, Kontak).

motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked text reveal using framer-motion (y: 100% to 0, overflow hidden wrapper).
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for an 'Editorial Ribbon' separating sections (e.g., 'DEYEDE CUSTOM • PREMIUM CONVECTION • DROP YOUR DESIGN •').
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Invert colors on hover for buttons (bg-white text-black -> bg-transparent text-white border-white). Image hover: slight scale (scale-105) with long duration (duration-700).
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in/out between pages using framer-motion AnimatePresence.

home_hero.description: Bold tagline 'DROP YOUR DESIGN'. Logo at top. Signature background pattern giving texture.

catalog_section.description: Grid of products (Kaos, Hoodie, Kemeja, Jaket, dll). Use sharp-edged cards. Hovering over a card reveals the garment in subtle color, otherwise strict B&W.

steps_section.description: 4 Steps (Konsultasi, Desain, Produksi, Pengiriman). Use massive Mono font for numbers (01, 02...). Display in an asymmetrical grid.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence. White text on black background inherently passes APCA. Ensure muted text is at least text-white/60.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='nav-link-katalog', data-testid='wa-cta-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a multi-page React application using react-router-dom.
Implement the specific fonts via Google Fonts (Playfair Display, Manrope, IBM Plex Mono) in index.html or global css.
Set the Tailwind config to use these fonts and strictly use the monochrome palette.
DO NOT use rounded corners; this design relies on sharp, brutalist, high-fashion edges (rounded-none).
Implement the background image (signature_background) as a fixed or absolute background with object-cover and opacity control.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for structural creative layouts rather than rigid Shadcn wrappers where artistic overlap is needed.
Install and use `react-fast-marquee` for the text ribbon.
Ensure all copy is in Bahasa Indonesia as requested.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' layouts. Make this feel like an Awwwards winner.
Create depth using z-index and typography scale, not drop shadows.
Add micro-interactions (framer-motion) to every clickable element.
Never center-align paragraphs; left-align text to maintain an editorial reading flow.
Do NOT use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided Unsplash URLs and brand assets.
Do NOT use emojis as icons. Use lucide-react.
Implement smooth scrolling (Lenis) if setting up the global layout.
Include data-testid on every interactive component for automated testing.
